name: WE3SCS Supply Chain
subtitle: Commercial Freight & Logistics Services
challenge: Generate qualified commercial freight enquiries for full container load (FCL) and less than container load (LCL) shipments while filtering out unqualified consumer parcel queries and high CPC bidding wars.
approach: Segmented Google Search campaigns around commercial supply chain terms including FCL container bookings, port-to-port logistics, and bonded warehousing.
Engineered comprehensive negative keyword lists pruning 350+ retail, household moving, and small parcel terms.
Constructed targeted Responsive Search Ads featuring real-time transit schedule transparency and custom customs clearance support.
Integrated GA4 event tracking with CRM lead notifications for rapid sales desk dispatch.
result: Delivered 54 verified commercial freight enquiries with a 7.57% Search CTR and reduced qualified Cost Per Lead by 42.3% (reaching ₹837 target CPL).

strategies.title: 01 COMMERCIAL CARGO KEYWORD SEGMENTATION
strategies.description: Structured ad groups around exact commercial queries including FCL sea freight, air charter logistics, and bonded supply chain management.

strategies.title: 02 NEGATIVE KEYWORD FORTIFICATION
strategies.description: Aggressively negative-matched retail courier and personal baggage keywords, protecting client ad spend from low-intent consumer clicks.

strategies.title: 03 INDUSTRIAL CALL & SITELINK EXTENSIONS
strategies.description: Configured custom ad assets highlighting port network reach, container tracking, and instant customs clearance quotation.

snapshots.caption: Verified Google Ads campaign dashboard showing commercial freight inquiries and CTR optimization.
snapshots.note: Achieved 7.57% Search CTR on high-intent supply chain queries.

timeline.title: COMMERCIAL AUDIT
timeline.description: Full audit of past campaign search terms and competitor bidding structures in industrial freight.

timeline.title: KEYWORD RE-ARCHITECTING
timeline.description: Transition to phrase and exact match commercial shipping routes with geo-targeted bid adjustments.

timeline.title: QUOTE FUNNEL DEPLOYMENT
timeline.description: Form streamlined to capture origin/destination ports, cargo tonnage, and expected departure dates.

keyLearnings: Exact-match industrial freight keywords yielded 2.4x higher lead-to-booking conversions compared to broad logistics terms.
Adding mandatory destination port and cargo weight fields eliminated non-commercial inquiries without reducing sales volume.
Target CPA bidding stabilized acquisition costs across high-competition trade lanes.
